description: Account-scoped X/Twitter archive import, identity custody, body-free health, and honest archive coverage.

cases.criterion: A registered account has independent private paths and appears as export-required in unified status.
Direct Messages import from a downloaded account ZIP without exposing bodies in operational output.
An archive from a different username is rejected before any message import.
Separate group-DM files are imported and counted rather than silently omitted.
Imported threads have an account-specific filesystem view without an unsupported full-history claim.
The hourly run-at-login job executes the installed private runtime and writes a source receipt.
Invalid archives preserve last-known-good custody and do not stop independent accounts.
Overlapping cumulative archives do not inflate canonical message or thread counts.
Provider request evidence does not imply delivery, import, or historical completeness.
Missing provider identity cannot borrow the configured handle to bypass archive validation.
Account keys are literal identifiers, not SQL wildcard patterns.
